description: CollectChoice: the caller selects from a menu of offered options (fare class, plan tier, room type, coverage level, delivery method, channel). A misheard choice is cheap to recover because the caller hears the option folded into the next question, so the agent should echo and advance rather than stop for a confirmation round trip on every pick.

subtle: Echo the chosen option into the next question instead of asking about it separately
Open agent turns with the value itself so no two turns start the same way
Bare value-as-question only where the pick was garbled, corrected, or genuinely ambiguous
Silent accept for options the caller stated emphatically or repeated
Fold several picks into one late summary rather than confirming each atom on the spot
One-beat correction: re-echo the new option and keep moving
Contractions throughout, short clauses, commas instead of dashes
One reason on a refusal, then drop it
Strict readback survives for codes, emails, card digits, dates of birth and consent
non_subtle_tells: Same confirmation template on every option: I heard X, is that correct
Just to confirm / you have selected X on picks nobody would stop for
Repeated canned ack: Got it, Got it, Got it
Praise on trivial answers: excellent choice, perfect
Status phrases: I have noted that, your selection has been recorded
No contractions, over-formal register, kindly, I will now proceed to
A confirm round trip on literally every field
Chatbot closer: is there anything else I can help you with today
Wrong direction: over-casual agent that drops a fidelity floor such as the char-by-char readback of a reference or explicit consent
